one day, a boy named tim went for a walk. he saw a big rock. the rock was rude. it said mean things to tim. tim was sad. tim had an idea. he said sorry to the rock. the rock did not expect that. the rock felt regret. it said sorry to tim too. now, tim and the rock were friends. they played and had fun. they were both happy. the rude rock was now a nice rock.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named lily. lily loved to eat pastry. one day, she went to the bakery with her mom. lily was very happy. in the bakery, lily saw a big pastry. she wanted to eat it. lily asked her mom, "mom, can i have the big pastry, please?" her mom said, "yes, you can have it." lily tried to pull the pastry from the shelf, but it was too high. she tried again and again. finally, her mom helped her. they pulled the pastry together. lily and her mom went home and ate the pastry. they were very happy.

once upon a time, there was a polite lawyer. he lived in a small house. he had many friends because he was nice. one day, the lawyer went to the park. he saw a big tree. he wanted to disappear like magic. he said to his friend, "i want to disappear!" his friend laughed and said, "you can't do that!" the lawyer tried to disappear. he closed his eyes and wished very hard. but he did not disappear. instead, he fell into a hole. his friend looked for him, but could not find him. and the polite lawyer was never seen again.

one day, a smart dog named spot lived in a small house. he liked to help people. spot had a job. his job was to help when there was an emergency. one day, spot saw a broken toy. a little girl was sad. she needed help. spot knew what to do. he would replace the broken toy with a new one. spot went to the store. he found a new toy. he took the new toy to the little girl. she was happy again. spot felt good. he helped in an emergency by being smart and replacing the toy.

once upon a time, there was a cute dog named tiny. tiny liked to play with his red ball. he would throw the ball and run to get it. tiny was very happy. one day, tiny saw a big hill. tiny wanted to play with his ball on top of the hill. he did not know that the hill was very steep. tiny threw the ball and it went up, up, up. tiny tried to run up the hill, but it was too hard. tiny tried and tried, but he could not get to the top. the ball rolled down the hill and went far away. tiny was very sad. he could not find his ball. tiny learned that he should not play on steep hills.

once upon a time, there was a great museum. it had many fun things to see. in this museum, there was a big crab. the crab liked to pinch with its big claws. one day, a little girl named lucy went to the museum with her mom. lucy was very happy to see the big crab. she wanted to touch it, but her mom said, "be careful, the crab can pinch you!" lucy listened to her mom, and did not touch the crab. they had a fun day at the great museum. when they went home, lucy told her dad about the crab and how she was careful not to get pinched. her dad was very proud of her.

once upon a time, there was a nice seal. the seal lived in the sea. the seal liked to play and feel the water on its skin. the seal had many friends in the sea. one day, the seal met a big fish. the big fish wanted to play with the seal. they played together and had lots of fun. the seal felt happy to have a new friend. but the big fish was not a nice friend. one day, the big fish ate the seal. the seal was gone. the sea was sad without the nice seal.

charlie and lily were happy outside playing. lily had a big blue box and inside was a red strip. she put it on the grass and said "let's slide!" charlie laughed and said "yay!" they both sat on the red strip and held each other's hands. they pushed themselves and started to slide. they laughed as they slid along and faster and faster. suddenly, as they reached the end of the slide, charlie and lily both shouted "whee!". they felt so happy. lily said "let's do that again". charlie smiled and they both started sliding again. they had lots of fun sliding all morning and they just couldn't stop!

one day, a cat saw an ashtray on a table. the cat wanted to steal the ashtray because it was shiny. so, the cat jumped on the table and took the ashtray in its mouth. the cat ran away with the ashtray. the cat's friend, a dog, saw the cat with the ashtray. the dog said, "why did you steal the ashtray? that is not good." the cat felt bad and knew the dog was right. the cat took the ashtray back to the table and put it where it was before. the dog said, "good job! now you did a good thing." the cat and the dog played together and were happy.

once upon a time, there was a toy. the toy was wide and fun. it liked to go fast. one day, the toy met a little girl named sue. "hi, toy!" said sue. one day, a nice cat went for a walk in the park. the cat saw a big tree and wanted to climb it. the tree had many branches and green leaves. the nice cat started to climb the tree. it went up and up. the cat was very happy. it saw many birds and their nests in the tree. the cat paused to look around. it saw a little girl playing with a ball. the girl looked up and saw the cat. she said, "hi, nice cat!" the cat climbed down and played with the girl. they had a fun day in the park.

once upon a time, there was a tall man. he liked to dress in big, funny clothes. every day, he cooked food in a big pan. one day, the tall man saw a little cat. the cat was hungry. the tall man wanted to help. he put food in the pan for the cat. but, the cat jumped in the pan! the tall man was surprised. the cat was not a cat. it was a magic cat! the magic cat made the tall man small. now, the tall man and the magic cat had fun together.

once upon a time, there was a pink cat named kitty. kitty loved to nap in the warm sun. one day, while napping, she saw a big envelope on the ground. kitty went to the envelope and said, "what's this?" she opened it and found a pretty picture inside. the picture was of a big, yummy cake. kitty wanted to find the cake. kitty asked her friend doggy, "do you know where the cake is?" doggy said, "yes, follow me!" they walked and walked until they found the cake. kitty and doggy were very happy and ate the cake together.

once upon a time, there was a friendly cat. the cat loved to speak. it would speak to everyone it met. the cat had a special love for jazz music. one day, the cat went to a park. in the park, it heard some jazz music. the cat was very happy. it followed the sound of the music and found a band playing jazz. the friendly cat started to speak with the band. the band liked the cat. they asked the cat to join them. the cat danced and spoke while the band played jazz. everyone at the park had fun with the friendly cat and the jazz band.

one day, a little boy named tim found a rope in his yard. he was excited. he wanted to play with the rope. tim had an idea. he called his friend, lily, to come and play with him. when lily came, tim said, "let's play with the rope!" they decided to play a game. they took turns jumping over the rope. they laughed and had fun. after a while, they were tired. they sat down and looked at the rope. tim said, "i'm happy we played with the rope today." lily agreed. they went home with big smiles on their faces.

one day, a big bird named will was eager to play. he flew to his friend tom's house. one day, a small shrimp was playing near the sea. he saw a big swing and wanted to play on it. but the shrimp was fearful. he did not know if he could swing on it. the shrimp saw a big fish and asked, "can you help me swing?" the big fish said, "yes, i can help you." the shrimp was happy. they went to the swing together. but the big fish was not nice. he pushed the shrimp very hard. the shrimp went very high and was scared. the big fish laughed. then, a big bird came and took the big fish away. the shrimp was safe and learned to swing on his own.

sam and jake were best friends. they were good at playing together. one day, sam was playing in the garden when he saw a smooth leaf. it was so pretty! he decided he had to have it. but jake saw the leaf too. he wanted it too! so sam and jake began to quarrel about who should keep the leaf. their parents heard the quarrel and came to help. they said that sam and jake should share the leaf. so the both took the leaf and went off happily to play. the end!

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim had a big, red door in his room. every night, he would lie in his bed and look at the door. he felt safe because the door was always closed. one day, tim's friend, sam, came to play. sam said, "i like your red door. it looks strong and reliable." tim smiled and said, "yes, it keeps me safe at night." the next day, tim and sam played near the door. they pretended to be superheroes, protecting the door from bad guys. they knew that as long as the door was closed, they were safe and sound.

once upon a time, there was a pretty doll named lily. lily was very happy. she had many friends. one day, lily saw a new doll named mia. mia was sad. mia had a stitch on her face. lily wanted to help mia. lily said, "let's play." mia said, "no, i have a stitch." lily said, "i will help you." they went to find a friend who could help fix the stitch. they found a friend named sam. sam was good at fixing things. sam fixed the stitch on mia's face. mia was very happy. now, mia and lily could play together. they all became best friends.

one day, a little girl named lily was very eager to play. she ran to her room and looked in her mirror. she saw her big smile and her blue dress. lily liked how she looked in the mirror. lily wanted to show her mom her pretty dress. she ran to the kitchen and shouted, "mom, look at me!" her mom looked up and smiled. once upon a time, there was a small dog named tim. tim loved to play with his hoop. it was a very attractive hoop, with many colors. one day, tim saw a big cat. the cat made tim tremble because it was so big. the cat saw tim's hoop and wanted to play too. tim and the cat played with the hoop together. they had lots of fun. in the end, they became good friends and were not scared of each other anymore.

once upon a time, there was a muffin. the muffin was very strong. he lived in a little house on a hill. one day, the muffin went for a walk in the forest. in the forest, the muffin met a little bird. the bird said, "hello, muffin! you are very strong. can you help me find my friend?" the muffin said, "yes, i can help you." they looked and looked, and soon they found the bird's friend. the friend was very happy to see them. the muffin was glad he could help. the birds said, "thank you, strong muffin!" and they all played together in the forest.

one day, a little girl named lily went to the park. she saw her friend, tim, who was wearing an orange shirt. they wanted to play a game, but they did not know which game to play. lily said, "i recommend we do a dance!" tim was not sure. he did not like to dance. he felt shy. this made lily sad. they thought for a moment. then, tim said, "okay, let's do the dance together!" they both danced and laughed. they had so much fun, and tim was not shy anymore.

once upon a time, there was a boy named tim. tim was not patient. he wanted everything right away. one day, tim found a mine. it was a big hole in the ground where people dig for shiny rocks. tim went inside the mine to find shiny rocks. he did not listen to his mom who said, "be patient, tim. the mine can be dangerous." tim did not care. he wanted the shiny rocks now. in the mine, tim found a big shiny rock. he was so happy. but then, the mine started to shake. tim was scared. he tried to leave, but it was too late. the mine fell down on tim. tim regret not being patient.

once upon a time, a little boy named tim found a shiny trophy in his room. he did not remember where it came from. it was big and pretty. tim was very happy to have it. one day, tim met a harmless little bug named buzz. buzz liked the trophy too. they both played with the trophy and had a lot of fun. buzz said, "tim, can i see the trophy again tomorrow?" tim said, "yes, buzz! we can play together every day." tim and buzz became best friends. they always played with the trophy and shared many happy days. they remembered to be kind and gentle with each other. and they lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a funny dog. the dog lived in a house with a big backyard. the dog loved to play in the backyard all day. one day, the dog found a big, round ball. the ball was old and starting to rot. the dog did not care. the dog played with the ball all day long. the next day, the dog's friend, a little cat, came to visit. the cat saw the rotting ball and wanted to play too. the funny dog and the little cat played with the ball in the backyard. they had so much fun and were very happy.

once upon a time, there was a big train. the train had a name. its name was tom. tom liked to go fast on the rails. tom went to many places on the rails. one day, tom saw a distant place. tom wanted to go there. tom asked his friend, the bird, to help him. the bird said, "yes, i will help you, tom." the bird flew high and showed tom the way. tom went on the rails to the distant place. tom was happy. the bird was happy, too. they were the best friends.

one day, a cat and a dog were friends. they liked to cook together. the cat would mix things in a big pot, and the dog would taste it. they were having fun. then, a big flood came. the water was high and tight around their home. the cat and the dog were scared. they did not know what to do. the cat said, "let's cook something to make us feel better." the dog agreed. they cooked a big, tasty meal. as they ate, the flood went away. the cat and the dog were happy and safe. they learned that cooking together made them feel better, even when things were scary.

once upon a time, there was a little bunny who loved to jump. one day, the bunny saw a hidden hanger in the woods. the hanger was big and shiny. the bunny wanted to play with it. the bunny started to jump near the hanger. it jumped higher and higher, trying to touch the hanger. the bunny was having a lot of fun. it did not see the big hole near the hanger. the bunny jumped one more time. but this time, it fell into the big hole. the bunny was very sad and could not get out. the hidden hanger was not fun anymore. the bunny stayed in the hole, and it was a bad ending.

one day, a little boy named tim found a brilliant red wagon. he decided to use it to carry his toys. he put his bear, ball, and blocks in the wagon. tim was happy to have a new wagon. tim went to the park with his wagon. he met a girl named sue. sue liked tim's wagon too. they played together with the wagon and their toys. they had lots of fun at the park. soon, it was time to go home. tim and sue said goodbye. tim used his wagon to carry his toys back home. he was very happy to have a brilliant red wagon and a new friend.

once upon a time, there was a charming sailor. he had a big boat with a big sail. he liked to sail on the water. one day, the boat got a hole. the charming sailor was sad. he wanted to fix the hole and make his boat good again. he needed to restore his boat. the sailor worked very hard. he fixed the hole and made his boat good again. now, the charming sailor could sail on the water and be happy.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named lily. she loved to dress up in pretty clothes. one day, she put on her favorite dress and went to a fun party. at the party, there was a big table with a menu. the menu had pictures of all the tasty foods. lily looked at the menu and saw a picture of a yummy cake. she wanted to eat the cake. lily asked her mommy for a piece of cake. her mommy said, "yes, you can have some cake." lily ate the tasty cake and was very happy. she played with her friends and had a great time at the party.

once upon a time, there was a big mall. in the mall, there were many shops. one day, a little girl named sue went to the mall with her mom. they wanted to buy a new dress for sue. in the mall, they saw a nice lady. the nice lady had many dresses. sue tried on a dress, but it was uncomfortable. sue did not like the dress. the nice lady wanted to help. she said, "i can lend you another dress to try." sue tried the new dress. it was not uncomfortable. it was very pretty. sue and her mom were happy. they said "thank you" to the nice lady. sue wore the new dress, and they went home.

one day, a boy named tim went to the park. he saw a big pitch where kids played ball. tim wanted to play too. he ran fast and kicked the ball. all the kids clapped and cheered. in the park, there was a water spray. tim was hot from playing. he went to the spray to cool down. the water felt nice and cold. tim laughed and splashed with his new friends. a deaf dog named max lived near the park. max could not hear, but he liked to watch the kids play. tim saw max and gave him a pat. max wagged his tail. they all played together and had a fun day.

one day, tom and sue went to the shore. they saw the big, open water. they were very happy. tom said, "sue, let's go close to the water!" sue said, "yes, let's go!" they ran to the water and played in the sand. then, something unexpected happened. a big fish jumped out of the water! it said, "hi, kids!" tom and sue were very surprised. they had fun with the big fish and played all day at the shore.

one day, a boy named tim went to a camp. at camp, he met a girl named amy. they both liked to play games. tim and amy were competitive and wanted to win. they played a game called "slap the ball." tim said, "i will win!" amy said, "no, i will win!" they took turns to slap the ball. the ball went very fast. they both tried hard to win. in the end, tim won the game. amy was sad, but tim said, "you played well too!" they both smiled and played more games together. they had fun at camp and became good friends.

one day, a boy named tim went to the park with his mom. he wore a thick coat with a zip. tim saw a big tree and wanted to climb it. his mom said, "be careful, tim!" tim started to climb the tree. he saw a bird and said, "hi, bird!" the bird said, "hi, tim! i admire your coat with the zip." tim was happy the bird liked his coat. they talked and became friends. then, something unexpected happened. the bird showed tim that it could also zip and unzip its feathers! tim was so surprised. they both laughed and played together in the park.

once upon a time, there was a little girl named lily. she loved to look at the trees in her backyard. one day, she saw a cherry tree. the tree was full of big, red cherries. lily wanted to pick a cherry from the tree. she tried to reach up, but she was too small. she felt embarrassed. her big brother, tom, saw her and wanted to help. tom picked a cherry for lily. she was so happy! they both ate the cherries and laughed. now, every time they look at the cherry tree, they remember that fun day.

once upon a time, there was a yellow grill. it sat in the garden, dazzling in the sunshine. one day, a girl wanted to use the grill. but it was all dirty, so she had to wash it. she found a bucket and filled it with water. then she grabbed a cloth, dipped it in the bucket and started to scrub. the grill sparkled when she was done. now it was ready for grilling! the girl was happy and so was the yellow grill.

once upon a time, there was a boy named tim. he had a pretty bike and a big helmet. one day, tim wanted to go to the park. at the park, tim saw a girl with an attractive red helmet. she was riding a bike too. tim said, "hi! i like your red helmet. want to play?" the girl smiled and said, "yes! my name is amy. let's ride our bikes together!" so, tim and amy rode their bikes around the park. they had so much fun. and from that day, they became good friends.

once upon a time, there was a kind girl named sue. she liked to help people. one day, sue saw a boy who fell off his bike. the boy cried and said, "my leg hurts!" sue said, "we must go to the hospital. they will make your leg feel better." the boy didn't want to go. he was scared. but sue insisted, "don't worry, i will go with you." at the hospital, the nice doctor looked at the boy's leg. the doctor put a bandage on it. the boy felt better. he said, "thank you, sue, for being kind and helping me." sue smiled and they became good friends.

once upon a time, there was a little structure. the structure was a house. the house was red and blue. it was a happy house. one day, a boy named tim wanted to go inside the house. tim was eager to see the house. he said, "house, can i go inside?" the house said, "yes, come in!" tim went inside the house. he saw a big room with many toys. tim was so happy. he played with the toys all day long. the house was happy too. they had a fun day together.

once upon a time, there was a helpful dog named spot. spot liked to watch the birds in the sky. one sunny day, spot saw his shadow on the ground. he thought it was another dog. spot wanted to play with the shadow. spot ran after the shadow. the shadow ran too. spot was having fun. he chased the shadow all day. it was a fun game. at the end of the day, spot was tired. he lay down under a tree. the shadow lay down too. spot smiled at the shadow. they were friends now. the helpful dog and his shadow had a very fun day.

one day, tom and sue went to the park. they saw a big motor toy car. tom wanted to choose the red car, but sue wanted to choose the blue car. they did not know what to do. tom said, "let's choose the red car." sue was upset. she said, "no, i want the blue car!" they could not agree. in the end, they chose to share both cars. they played together and had lots of fun. tom and sue were not upset anymore. they learned that sharing is better than choosing just one thing.

once there was a girl named lily. she liked to whistle and play. one day, she went to the park. she saw a big tree and a swing. lily was an independent girl, so she went to the swing alone. while swinging, she met a boy named tom. tom asked, "can i play with you?" lily said, "yes, let's play together!" they had fun playing on the swing and running around the tree. lily and tom became friends. they liked to whistle and play together. they were both happy and independent. they played at the park every day, and their friendship grew.

once upon a time, there was a tidy cat named fluffy. fluffy loved to dance. one day, fluffy heard a noise outside. it was music! fluffy went outside to see where the noise was coming from. fluffy saw a big dog named spot. spot was playing with a music box. fluffy asked, "can i dance to your noise, spot?" spot said, "yes! let's dance together, fluffy!" so fluffy and spot danced and danced. but then, the music box broke. it made a loud, scary noise. fluffy and spot stopped dancing. they were sad. the music was gone, and they couldn't dance anymore.

one day, a boy named tim went to the park. he wore his favorite hat. it was a big, red hat. tim liked to show his hat to all his friends. they all thought it was a cool hat. at the park, tim saw his friend sue. he said, "sue, look at my hat!" sue looked at the hat, but she did not smile. she looked embarrassed. tim did not know why sue was embarrassed. suddenly, a bird flew down from the sky. it took tim's hat right off his head! tim and sue were surprised. the bird put the hat in its nest. tim and sue laughed. they were not embarrassed anymore. they played in the park without the hat.

once, there was a leak. it was a sweet leak, and it made a lot of bubbles. every day, the leak made more and more bubbles. but, one day, something started to destroy the bubbles. it was a monster! the monster smashed the bubbles and made the leak stop. it was so sad, the sweet leak was gone. but then, something magical happened! a magical fairy came and gave the leak a special power. the special power was the power to make bubbles again! the magical fairy helped the leak start making bubbles again. soon, the leak was back to its sweet and bubbly self. everyone was so happy!

one day, a white cat named whistle went to the park. whistle liked to play with her friends there. they would run, jump, and have fun. whistle loved the park. whistle saw her friend, tuna the dog, at the park. tuna said, "hi whistle! do you want to play with me?" whistle said, "yes, let's play!" they played for a long time, laughing and having fun. suddenly, they saw a big box. they went to look at it. when they opened the box, many balloons came out! whistle and tuna were very surprised. they played with the balloons and had even more fun. it was a great day at the park.

one day, a green frog named bob found a big box. he jumped inside to see what was there. it was dark and he could not see. bob wanted to get out, but the box was too high. a little girl named sue saw the box. she heard bob say, "help, i want to escape!" sue wanted to help the frog. she tried to push the box, but it was very heavy. sue asked her friend tom for help. they both pushed the box together. the box fell over and bob the green frog jumped out. he was happy to escape. bob said, "thank you!" and hopped away. sue and tom were happy they could help bob the frog.

once upon a time, there was a big sunflower. the sunflower had a big, open smile. it lived in a pretty garden with many other flowers. they were all very happy. one day, a little girl came to the garden. she saw the big sunflower with the open smile. she started to laugh. the sunflower laughed too. they both laughed together. it was a fun day. the little girl came back to the garden every day. she played with the sunflower and they laughed a lot. the sunflower was her best friend. they were always happy when they were together.

once upon a time, there was a bald man named tom. tom had a favorite spot under a big tree. he liked to sit there and watch the birds play. one day, tom saw a little bird fall from the tree. the bird was sad and hurt. tom wanted to help and comfort the bird. he picked up the bird and held it in his hands. tom took the bird to his spot under the tree. he made a soft bed for the bird with leaves and grass. the bird felt safe and happy. soon, the bird got better and flew back to its family. tom smiled and knew he had helped his new friend.

once upon a time, there was a magic cat named bob. bob had a fancy hat that he loved to wear. one day, bob went to a big park to play with his friends. in the park, he saw a big tree with a kite stuck in it. bob said to his friends, "i will raise my paws and use my magic to get the kite down." he raised his paws and the kite came down. all his friends clapped and cheered. after playing, bob and his friends went home. they were happy because they had a fun day. bob was proud that he could use his magic to help his friends. and he wore his fancy hat all the way home.

one day, a little boy named tim was very excited. he found a big box in his room. he opened the box and saw many colors inside. the colors were ink for drawing pretty pictures. tim took the ink and started to draw. he drew a big, blue sky and a bright, yellow sun. he was so happy with his picture. but, he forgot to shut the ink bottles. the ink spilled on the floor and made a big mess. tim's mom saw the mess and helped him clean it up. she told him to always shut the ink bottles when he was done. tim learned his lesson and promised to be more careful next time.

one day, a girl named sarah went for a walk. she saw a fancy hat on the ground. she picked it up and put it on her head. sarah felt very happy with her new hat. she met her friend, tom. once upon a time, there was a colorful shoe. the shoe liked to roll all day. one day, the shoe rolled down a big hill. as the shoe rolled, it saw a big tree. the tree had green leaves and was very tall. the shoe wanted to roll up the tree, but it could not. then, the shoe met a little bug. the bug was sad because it could not climb the tree. the shoe had an idea. it let the bug sit on it, and they rolled up the tree together. they were both happy and played in the tree all day.

once upon a time, there was a little boy named tim. tim was a very frightened boy. he was scared of a lot of things. one day, his mom made him a big dinner. it had many yummy things on the plate. but tim saw a green thing on his plate. it was a tiny tree called broccoli. tim did not like broccoli. he looked at it and said, "no, i don't want it!" tim refused to eat the broccoli. his mom said, "you need to eat your dinner, tim." tim felt scared, but he knew his mom was right. so, he took a small bite of the broccoli. it was not that bad! tim ate all his dinner and was not frightened anymore.

one day, a girl named lucy went to the river with her raft. she was very organized and had her toys, food, and hat with her. lucy liked to play on her raft and have fun. lucy put her raft in the water and climbed on. she saw a duck and wanted to pay the duck with her food. she gave the duck some bread and the duck was happy. lucy was happy too. after playing with the duck, lucy went back to her raft. she put her toys and food back in her bag. she was very organized. lucy had a fun day on her raft with her new duck friend.

one day, a kind cop named tom was walking in the park. he saw a little boy named sam playing with his ball. sam was very happy, and the cop liked to see him smile. suddenly, a big wind came and took sam's ball away. sam was sad and started to cry. the kind cop wanted to help him. he looked around and saw the ball near a tree. the cop ran to the tree and slapped the ball back to sam. sam was happy again and thanked the kind cop. they both played with the ball and had a fun day in the park.

once upon a time, there was a stubborn cat named tim. tim liked to do yoga every day. he would stretch and bend in the sun. tim was very happy. one day, while tim was doing yoga in the garden, a small bird came to watch him. the bird was scared of a big dog that wanted to catch it. tim saw the dog and wanted to protect the bird. tim stood tall and hissed at the dog. the dog was surprised and ran away. the bird thanked tim for protecting it. tim and the bird became best friends, and they did yoga together every day.

once upon a time, there was a big, warm sun. it was so wide and bright that it made everyone happy. the sun loved to celebrate with all the animals and people on earth. one day, the sun decided to have a party. it invited all the animals and people to come and celebrate. the animals and people were very excited. they all came to the party and had lots of fun. at the party, the animals danced and played. the people sang and laughed. everyone was so happy to celebrate with the wide, warm sun. they all had a great time and couldn't wait for the next celebration.

once upon a time, there was a young boy named tim. tim went to school every day. he liked to draw on the blackboard. one day, tim found a sharp rock outside. he thought it would be fun to draw with it. tim took the sharp rock to the blackboard. he started to draw a big sun. his friend, sam, saw him and said, "wow, tim! that looks good!" tim smiled and said, "thank you, sam! i used a sharp rock to draw. it works great!" sam wanted to try too. so, they both drew on the blackboard with the sharp rock. they had lots of fun drawing together.

once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a little yellow bird. the bird had many friends. they played and sang all day long. the little bird was happy. one day, the little yellow bird saw a big cat. the cat was hungry and wanted to eat the bird. the bird felt uncomfortable. the cat was getting closer and closer. the bird had to warn its friends. it flew to them and said, "big cat is coming! we must hide!" all the friends hid in the trees. they were safe. the big cat could not find them. they were happy again.

once upon a time, there was a big dog named max. max loved to dig in the dirt. one day, max dug a big pit in the yard. he was so happy with his pit. max wanted to share his pit with his friend, a small cat named lily. max went to lily's house to introduce her to his pit. lily was curious and wanted to see the pit. when lily saw the pit, she was very grateful. she thought it was the perfect spot to play and hide. max and lily played in the pit all day long. they were the best of friends and had so much fun together.

once upon a time, there was a bright medal. it was very shiny and pretty. the medal lived in a big box with other medals. they all belonged to a nice man who won them in races. one day, the bright medal fell out of the box. it was very sad and wanted to go back home. the medal tried to jump, but it could not jump high enough to reach the box. a small boy saw the bright medal on the ground. he picked it up and saw how sad it was. the boy put the medal back in the box with its friends. the medal was very happy to belong with its friends again. and they all lived happily ever after.

once upon a time, there was a brilliant girl named lucy. she loved to fix things. one day, she saw a broken toy planet. lucy wanted to make it better. lucy asked her friend, tom, "can you help me fix this toy planet?" tom said, "yes, i can help you!" they worked together to make the toy planet look like new. when they were done, the toy planet was beautiful again. lucy and tom were very happy. they played with the toy planet all day, and they knew they could fix anything together.

one day, a weak dog named spot went for a walk. he saw a big tree with a cut on it. spot wondered what could have made the cut. he kept walking and saw his friend, a cat named luna. "hi luna!" spot said. once upon a time there was a big, orange muscle. everyone was amazed at how strong it was! one day, the muscle went to the park. it saw its friend, a little mouse. the mouse said, "oh no! i'm stuck. can you help me?" the muscle said, "yes! i have a plan. i will reverse and then i will be stronger. that will help us both!" so the muscle reversed. it became stronger, and was able to pull the mouse from where it was stuck. the mouse said, "thank you! you are the strongest muscle i know!" the muscle said, "you're welcome! now let's go have some fun!"

one day, a boy named tim went to the park with his mom. they saw a big pitch where kids were playing ball. tim was happy and wanted to play too. tim's mom said, "okay, but don't go too far." tim went to play with the kids. they were having fun, but then an angry dog came. the dog wanted the ball. the kids got scared and paused. they did not know what to do. then, tim had an idea. he said, "let's give the dog the ball!" the kids threw the ball far away. the angry dog ran after it. the dog was not angry anymore, and the kids went back to playing. tim's mom was proud of him.

one day, a boy named tim went to the park. he wore his red cap. he saw a hungry duck near the pond. tim wanted to feed the duck. he looked for some food, but it was tough to find any. then, tim met a girl named sue. sue had a big bag of bread.
